prompts.name: kk_menhera_real
prompts.prompt: Image 1 is a screenshot of a chat. Create a REAL photograph of a smartphone screen displaying exactly image 1, taken very close with another phone, in the same photographic style as images 2 and 3 (amateur photo of a real phone screen). Requirements: the phone screen fills almost the entire frame, slightly tilted and in perspective, edges of the screen partly cut off by the frame, a thin dark phone bezel visible on one side. The screen content must be identical to image 1: same dark purple background with blurred hearts, same rounded purple-gray bubbles, same Korean text and line breaks, same gray avatars, same two red heart emojis, same small mosaic on one word. Add real-photo artifacts: subtle moire pattern from the screen pixels, a faint diagonal crack line across the glass, small dust specks and a fingerprint smudge on the glass, a soft reflection of a room light, slight blur and phone camera noise. Dark room. Do not copy any app icons, like counts, usernames or overlay buttons from images 2 and 3. No extra text, no watermark.
